source_anomalies.note: Enterprise Systems is present alongside Hardware-Grundlagen; no replacement binding for old students is established by these pages.
2023/2026 handbooks use PS for both Praktikum and Praxisseminar. Never resolve by this code alone.
Nachhaltigkeit has number 4 in handbook, also used for BWL2; use source-scoped requirement identity.

policies: Curriculum ECTS/weights/components remain in wi_editions.json; mappings never rewrite them.
All bindings are scoped to edition and semester; no future-semester fallback.
Handbook frequency is not evidence of cancellation, seats, admission or actual meetings.
Shared course identity allows shared offerings, but equivalence of assessment/credit is not inferred.
Historical transcript names remain intact; ambiguous recognition must not auto-complete a requirement.
Faculty-wide FWPM contents are intersected with IW X/(X) and section/slot membership.
Template FWPM parts labelled Vorlage are not courses.
